name: Flame ward belt
description: A grey web belt with a heavy black box at the buckle. A crossed-out flame on the lid glows violet, and the air around you feels cooler.
notes: Own model for the switched-on state: the crystal in the flame glows (`crystal-glow-violet`). A web belt 1.1 m long and 38 mm wide, laid flat in a U, outside up: the buckle run along +z and the tip run along -z, joined by the bend at +x, with a steel emitter box 90 by 64 mm on the buckle run at the right front, beside the buckle. The belt lies spread out, so its box is mostly air. A belt is the waist host: the box fills the right front, so four belt points take pouches: the left front on the buckle run's free end, the left hip on the tip run, the right hip past the box and the back at the bend. A belt takes the waist slot. The model shows the crystal set in the lid's emblem. The field it projects is a powered effect with no content field yet, so the draft carries no `protects`. It is worn, so the draft files it as clothing. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Crystal sight glasses
description: Thick black glasses with a pod on one arm. A violet crystal hums in the pod, and a pale blue display glows in one lens.
notes: Square-lensed glasses 150 mm across, standing on their lower rims with the temples folded behind, front on +z. Own model for the switched-on state: the display strip in the right lens and the crystal in the pod on the right temple glow. The glasses fill little of their box. The model shows a glowing crystal in the temple pod. What the glasses let the wearer see has no content field yet. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Crystal wrist computer
description: A slim green slate on a black wrist strap, its face a pane of blue crystal. It still keeps time, stores notes and tracks your heartbeat, though there is nothing left for it to talk to.
notes: A 48 by 34 mm slate in a jade-green housing with a crystal face, lying face up on its plastic strap laid open 210 mm long. It is worn on one wrist like a watch, so it takes `wrist`, as the diver's watch does, and sidedness has no content field. `timekeeping` reuses the watches' quality; its notes, health and camera functions have no content field yet. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
